translations.web: “ ‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.
translations.bsb: If, however, he brings a lamb as a sin offering, he must bring an unblemished female.
translations.kjv: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
translations.asv: And if he bring a lamb as his oblation for a sin-offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
